services.desc: Experience a delightful cruise on the beautiful Lake of the Ozarks, departing from the iconic Bagnell Dam in Lake Ozark, MO! Boarding: 12:00 pm Depart: 12:30 pm Return: 2:00 pm It is very important to arrive on time for boarding. Cruise Duration 1.5 Hours Total time including boarding 2 hours About Immerse yourself in the stunning natural beauty of the Lake of the Ozarks, as you indulge in a 1.5-hour scenic cruise. Take in the breathtaking views of the lake while being regaled with captivating stories of its rich history, all provided by a knowledgeable and friendly narrator.
